content: Go outbox: write event row in same pgx tx as state change; relay goroutine polls table (1-5s interval), publishes, marks delivered. Use aggregate_id as Kafka message key for per-aggregate ordering (partition-level). Do not rely on created_at for ordering across nodes (clock skew) - use a monotonic sequence/row id. Guarantee is at-least-once only; consumers must dedupe by event_id.
